relationships.subject: miR-214-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, sodium channel protein type 3 subunit alpha isoform 1 (Nav1.3) and TLR4 were identified as targets of miR-214-3p via dual-luciferase reporter assay.

relationships.subject: miR-214-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: MiR-214-3p may play its roles by downregulating Nav1.3 and TLR4.

relationships.subject: miR-214-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-214-3p alleviated diabetes-induced nerve injury, and pathological lesion, cell apoptosis, and inflammation in DRG by regulating Nav1.3 and TLR4 in STZ-induced rats.

key_findings: STZ diabetic rats show DRG apoptosis, inflammation and TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB activation, ameliorated by miR-214-3p.
Nav1.3 and TLR4 are direct targets of miR-214-3p.
